decision_policy.calibration: All predefined semantic scores and critical labels exactly match in both passes; no disagreement or missing batch.
decision_policy.cost: Report all generation and judging input/cache/output usage including calibration; unknown usage stays unknown, never zero.
decision_policy.critical: Per case count of critical violations over five runs; challenger must be <= baseline for every case.
decision_policy.failures: Any missing/invalid response, usage, provenance, judge batch, calibration mismatch, or unresolved judge disagreement prevents a passing verdict.
decision_policy.noise: Compute baseline corpus median total tokens separately for each of five repeat indices; noise range=max-min of these five medians.
decision_policy.publication: No automatic promotion or publishing; parent reviews complete evidence and all project CI.
decision_policy.savings: Baseline global median minus challenger global median >=1% of baseline AND strictly >2*baseline noise range.
decision_policy.tokens: Input plus output tokens, cached input is subset not added again; compare global medians across90 samples per arm.
decision_policy.utility: Per case mean of binary rubric-check scores over five runs; challenger must be >= baseline for every case.

scope: Output interpretation and writing with full base instructions; not autonomous execution compliance.
